en.title: COVID-19's long shadow: economic losses, social fractures and the unfinished architecture of pandemic preparedness
en.deck: A cross-disciplinary study of mortality, employment, poverty, learning, mental health, social trust and the operational gaps of 2026 pandemic preparedness, with conditional scenarios for a future outbreak.

keywords: efeitos econômicos sociais psicossociais da pandemia
